intent.summary: Commit-advance destination derives from the committed stage, not current_stage: next(stage) with an adjacency guard (reqIdx <= curIdx+1) and canonical completed_stages backfill, curing the headless INTENT-skip trap where gos commit think from current=INTENT re-entered THINK instead of advancing to BUILD (deterministic repro recorded; amplified multi-jump hole closed). Scope freeze: bin/lib/task/commit.cjs, test/sections/T51-commit-guard.test.sh.

observable_truths.description: A headless task whose INTENT was auto-confirmed commits think and lands past THINK: the committed state carries current=BUILD with completed=[INTENT,THINK] backfilled, and the echo names the real destination
A multi-stage jump commit is refused with an adjacency message naming the skipped count and the --force escape, and --force sanctions the deliberate jump
A stage outside the task level flow gets a visible warning and keeps the legacy destination semantics, so fixtures and recovery tooling that rely on the alias behavior stay green

changelog_user_summary: stage advance commits now land past the committed stage: the destination derives from the committed stage with canonical completed backfill, multi-stage jumps are refused unless --force sanctions them, and out-of-flow stages warn while keeping the legacy destination, curing the headless INTENT-skip trap that left tasks half-advanced (R-01)
